title.narrative: Scaling-up of high impact and integrated community interventions in the fight against HIV and TB - Burkina Faso (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Burkina Faso, TB/HIV, Initiative Privée et Communautaire pour la Santé et la Riposte au VIH/SIDA au Burkina Faso (IPC/BF) (IPC/BF)This program has the following goals: Reduce HIV prevalence from 1.0% to 0.83% by end of 2017. Reduce new infections by 21% between 2014 and 2017 (Spectrum 2014). Reduce TB prevalence from 80 cases per 100,000 population in 2013 to 72 cases per 100,000 population in Burkina Faso by the end 2017. Reduce the rate of mother-to-child HIV transmission to less than 5% by end of 2017. The objectives of this program are: Decrease mortality rate among TB/HIV co-infected patients from 19.6% (2013 cohort) to less than 5% by the end of 2017 (2016 cohort). Improve program management and availability, quality and use of strategic information. Increase the coverage of ARV treatment among children and adults living with HIV from 41% in 2014 to 58% by end of 2017. Increase treatment success rate of MDR-TB from 57.7% (2012 cohort) to at least 75% by end 2017 (2016 cohort). Increase treatment success rate of TB cases (all forms) from 79.8% (2013 cohort) to at least 90% by end of 2017 (2016 cohort);
